summary: A compiled TikZ figure exists. Best version is v4 (critic score 0.93). It reproduces the parallelogram ADCB with E on AD, base A-F-N-B, the solid E-G-B polyline with CG, and the dashed EC, DB, EN, GN edges. All eight labels A, B, C, D, E, F, G, N are present and topology_check passes. The earlier compile error came from an invalid 'dash' key, fixed with a 'dashed-edge' style. v5 (font 28/34) compiled but scored 0.92, so v4 remains best.
